name: Blood
description: Blood is the domain of hemocraft—blood magic that draws power from life essence itself. Practitioners of Blood magic sacrifice their own vitality to fuel devastating attacks, create protective wards, and manipulate the life force of others. This domain attracts those willing to pay the price of power in pain, making it favored by Blood Hunters and others who hunt monsters using the monsters' own dark methods.

name: Dread
description: Dread is the domain of fear, shadow, and psychological terror. Those who wield Dread magic tap into primal fears, summon horrors from beyond, and manipulate the minds of their enemies. This domain is favored by Witches and others who understand that sometimes the most powerful weapon is the terror that lurks in the darkness of the mind.
